content_sections.heading: Mahabubabad Anganwadi Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: The Mahabubabad Anganwadi Vacancy 2026 is spread across five separate notifications, one for each ICDS project in the district. The table below gives the project-wise and notification-wise vacancy break-up. Note: The Maripeda (137-4/2026) and Thorrur (137-5/2026) notifications call for Anganwadi Teacher posts only; no Anganwadi Helper vacancies are mentioned in these two notifications. Along with the notifications, the District Welfare Officer, WD&CW Mahabubabad has also released a detailed Anganwadi Centre (AWC) wise vacancy annexure showing the AWC ID, AWC name, sector, whether an AWT or AWH post is vacant at that specific centre, and the reserved category (SC/ST/BC/EWS/OC/General) for that post, along with the application window (25.08.2026 to 03.09.2026). This annexure covers AWCs under the Dornakal, Gudur, Mahabubabad, Maripeda, and Thorrur projects. Candidates are advised to check this AWC-wise list on the official website to confirm the exact Anganwadi Centre and reserved category applicable to their habitation before applying, since eligibility is linked to the specific AWC and its notified roster point.

content_sections.heading: Mahabubabad Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed Intermediate (Class 12) as the minimum qualification. For the Anganwadi Helper/Aya post, if Intermediate-qualified candidates are not available for a particular post, candidates who have passed 10th class (SSC) will be considered eligible, as per the notification. Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 01.07.2026. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying. Applicants must be local residents of the habitation/area served by the specific Anganwadi Centre they are applying for. For rural areas, the candidate must belong to the same Gram Panchayat as the Anganwadi Centre. For urban areas, the candidate must belong to the same Ward as the Anganwadi Centre. For AWT/AWH posts allotted to SC/ST sub-plan habitations, only SC/ST candidates belonging to that same habitation/ward are eligible. For AWT/AWH posts allotted to SC/ST sub-plan Gram Panchayats, only SC/ST candidates belonging to that same Gram Panchayat/Ward are eligible. Residence proof must compulsorily be obtained from the concerned Tahsildar; only residence proof certificates issued within one year from the date of this notification will be considered. Only candidates belonging to the caste/category (roster point) notified for that specific post will be considered eligible. If there is any change in a candidate's name, it will be considered only if it has been legally updated through a gazette notification or a court order. The notification permits the following categories of differently-abled women candidates to apply: Hearing-impaired candidates who can hear using an assistive device. Visually impaired candidates who can manage independently without the assistance of an escort. Candidates with disabilities relating to the legs or hands, provided the disability occurred prior to acquiring basic education and does not risk the safety of children while performing teaching duties.

content_sections.heading: Mahabubabad Anganwadi Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification does not describe a written examination. Based on the notification, the process involves: Online application submission by eligible candidates for the specific Anganwadi Centre and post. Scrutiny of applications as per the eligibility, local residency, and reservation (roster point) conditions. Document verification at the respective Project ICDS Office from 07.09.2026 to 19.09.2026, where candidates must produce original certificates along with two attested Xerox copies. Final selection based on merit within the eligible and verified candidates, as per the notified roster point for each post. Any further specific merit-list criteria or weightage scheme beyond this is not specified in the provided notification.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Mahabubabad Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload scanned copies of the following documents online: Date of birth/age proof certificate (SSC certificate) Caste certificate issued by the Tahsildar Educational qualification certificate (Intermediate or above marks memo) Residence certificate issued by the Tahsildar Disability certificate (if applicable) Husband's death certificate, for widow candidates (if applicable) Orphan certificate (if applicable) Sports certificate (if applicable) Ex-servicewoman/Ex-servicemen dependent certificate (if applicable) EWS certificate (if applicable)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Mahabubabad Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website: wdcw.tg.nic.in Locate the Mahabubabad District Anganwadi Teacher/Helper recruitment notification link. Register and fill in the online application form with personal, educational, and residency details. Upload scanned copies of the required certificates listed above. Submit the application before 03.09.2026, 5:00 PM. Keep a printout/copy of the submitted application for future reference and for document verification.

faq.question: Q1. What is Mahabubabad Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by WD&CW, Mahabubabad District to fill 231 Anganwadi Teacher (AWT) and Anganwadi Helper/Aya (AWH) posts across the Dornakal, Gudur, Mahabubabad, Maripeda, and Thorrur ICDS projects.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Mahabubabad Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 231 total vacancies — 101 Anganwadi Teacher posts and 130 Anganwadi Helper/Aya posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Mahabubabad Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 03.09.2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Mahabubabad Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Intermediate. For the Helper/Aya post, 10th class pass candidates may be considered if Intermediate-qualified candidates are unavailable for that post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Mahabubabad Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 01.07.2026.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for Mahabubabad Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through wdcw.tg.nic.in between 25.08.2026 and 03.09.2026.
